newsitem.title: UK: World lawyers urge Malaysia to halt libel writ.
newsitem.headline: World lawyers urge Malaysia to halt libel writ.

text.p: An international association of lawyers on Thursday urged the Malaysian government to protect a United Nations official from a libel suit brought against him.

The International Bar Association (IBA), which represents 2.5 million lawyers throughout the world, said the libel action filed in Malaysia last month against U.N. Special Rapporteur Dato' Param Cumaraswamy contradicts the immunity granted U.N. experts.
In what it describes as an exceptional case, the group has written to Malaysian Attorney General Datuk Mohtar Abdullah asking him to halt the action brought by two local companies.

"By ignorning Dato' Cumaraswamy's privileges and immunities Malasia will, in effect, remove his ability to carry out his U.N. function effectively," IBA president Desmond Fernando said in a statement.

"As the representative of the world's legal profession, the IBA urges the Malaysian government to take the necessary steps to ensure that immunities and privileges to which the U.N. Special Rapporteur is entitled are extended to him," he added.

The libel action brought by MBI Capital Bhd and Mbf Northern Securities Sdn Bhd, two Malaysian companies, stems from comments the U.N. official made to a London-based publication called International Commercial Litigation.
In the article he was quoted as saying he was investigating complaints that businessmen were manipulating the Malaysian judicial system.
The companies have also asked the High Court of Malaysia to issue an injunction to restrain the special rapporteur from further speaking or publishing words defamatory to them.
U.N. experts on special missions are granted privileges and immunities for the independent exercise of their functions under an article in the 1946 U.N. convention.
Both the U.N. and the IBA have said that any statements by Dato' Cumaraswamy were made in his capacity as a U.N. official and he should be protected against the libel action.
